name: Hashimoto Mika
source:
Until recently, she was a NEET! However, feeling inspired after watching a late-night anime, she decided to become an idol!

Socially awkward, she pretends to be living in a fantasy world. Armed only with her knowledge of otaku entertainment, she'll take on the idol business!

"I await your orders, Black Knight!"

[Based on [url=https://denpasoft.com/product/shining-song-starnova/]Denpasoft[/url]]
